doc.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Musical chemistry with Sweets Edison, Jake Hanna and Ray Brown
summary: Ellis names players he has felt a special chemistry with.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You know that says something about musicians striking a certain chemistry.
Can you tell us other musicians that you’ve had that chemistry with?

Oh let me see. Well there’s a lot of them. I had it with Sweets Edison, he’s here at the festival, you know. And I have it with Jake Hanna, the drummer. And of course I have it with Ray Brown to a great extent. We love to play together. So there could be more but I can’t name them all.
